newsitem.title: USA: Prudential names Melzer head Pru Mutual Funds. [CORRECTED 21:03 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Prudential names Melzer head Pru Mutual Funds. [CORRECTED 21:03 GMT]

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America's Money Management Group said on Thursday it named Mendel Melzer chief financial officer of Prudential Mutual Funds, succeeding Theresa A. Hamacher. (Corrects surname and job title.)

Melzer, 35, had been chief investment officer of Prudential's Money Management Group since November 1995. He worked for Prudential for 12 years, the comany said in a statement. He also led a private placement investment team at Prudential capital and was chief financial officer of Prudential Preferred Financial Services, the company said.
Melzer would be responsible for retail investment management, it said.
